abilene-bic-ks.assessment: Abilene BIC is one of three BIC congregations in this small Kansas town that anchors the BIC presence in the Midwest. Pastor Matt leads. The church website provides only a first-name reference, which is common practice in some Anabaptist congregations but limits external verification. The Brethren in Christ tradition combines Anabaptist (Mennonite-rooted) believer's baptism and peace witness with Pietist personal-holiness emphasis and Wesleyan sanctification. Yellow rating reflects the BIC denomination's women-in-ministry allowance and the limited public information about the local pastor's teaching specifics. For a man in Abilene seeking a smaller Anabaptist congregation, visit and ask about local elder polity.

score_notes.gender: Verified male senior pastor (referred to as "Pastor Matt" on church site); BIC denomination ordains women.
score_notes.leadership: Pastor Matt leads; BIC plural polity in background.

abingdon-episcopal-gloucester.assessment: Abingdon Episcopal Church at 4645 George Washington Memorial Hwy, Gloucester, VA 23061. A historic Episcopal parish (375+ years). Rev. Sven vanBaars is the 46th Rector (since 2010). Rev. Melanie Pressley serves as Minister for Youth and Children. As TEC (The Episcopal Church), the denomination affirms same-sex marriage and women's ordination at all levels. Historic and beautiful, but theological alignment with conservative evangelical convictions is a concern.

score_notes.christology: Episcopal liturgy retains Nicene/Apostles' Creeds; mission language is 'walk in love as Christ loved us' — orthodox in form but no explicit statement on site.
score_notes.scripture: TEC permits non-inerrantist hermeneutic; local Abingdon site does not publish an inerrancy statement.
score_notes.gender: TEC ordains women as priests and bishops since 1976; TEC permits same-sex marriage since 2015/2018 resolutions. Current rector listed as Sven vanBaars (male) but denomination's affirming stance governs.
score_notes.leadership: Episcopal polity — rector + vestry under diocesan bishop; TEC accountability structure does not meet biblical-eldership standard.
score_notes.soteriology: Episcopal sacramental framing; sola fide not articulated.
score_notes.cultural: TEC is denominationally LGBTQ-affirming (resolutions 2015/2018 expanded marriage rites church-wide). Local site does not publicly dissent.
score_notes.denominational: The Episcopal Church (TEC) — liberal mainline per rubric; black.
score_notes.preaching: Lectionary-based liturgical homily; not expository verse-by-verse.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Site lists 'Breath of Fresh Air Women's Spirituality Group' — no men's ministry surfaced.
score_notes.mission: Episcopal social-justice mission emphasis; gospel distinct from social action not articulated on site.

abingdon-episcopal-gloucester.gender_detail: Male rector locally, but TEC ordains women to all orders and affirms same-sex marriage; denomination-level categorization governs

abundant-life-ag-stafford-va.assessment: MOOP attended Abundant Life Assembly of God during his time at The Basic School (TBS, MCB Quantico). The 'back gate' of TBS opens north toward Stafford VA, and Abundant Life AG is the closest AG congregation in that direction (~3 miles from the base). Founded 1990 by a group concerned for the unchurched in Stafford. Pentecostal worship within an Assemblies of God denominational frame. YELLOW per MOOP rubric — same as the existing Conroe First and Spring First AG records — denominationally egalitarian though the local pastorate is male-led under Pastor Thomas L. Winstead.

score_notes.christology: AG Statement of Fundamental Truths is Trinitarian and orthodox.
score_notes.scripture: AG SFT affirms verbal inspiration and Scripture as the rule of faith and conduct.
score_notes.gender: AG has ordained women to all levels of ministry since 1914 (denominational egalitarianism). YELLOW per MOOP rubric — current pastor Thomas L. Winstead is male, but the denominational position is open.
score_notes.leadership: Pastor-led; AG polity allows female senior pastors at the denominational level.
score_notes.soteriology: Standard evangelical: grace through faith. AG distinctive: subsequence and evidence of Spirit baptism with tongues — characteristic Pentecostal soteriological add-ons.
score_notes.cultural: AG typically conservative on cultural issues, but yellow given Pentecostal practice variability congregation-to-congregation.
score_notes.preaching: Preaching style not visible from public materials reviewed; yellow until verified.
score_notes.mission: AG has one of the largest Pentecostal missionary footprints globally; missions emphasis is denomination-wide.
score_notes.denominational: Assemblies of God — yellow at the denominational level due to women's ordination position; otherwise broadly orthodox Pentecostal.
